entries.071ff2f173a2bda1: A company that operates three businesses, centered on matching professional talent and combining the Regional Revitalization Business and the Solution Business.
entries.29b05f544fb6ccf4: Local governments and regional financial institutions
entries.762a0e007f40e6b6: A service specializing in digital and creative talent that matches freelance, side-job and regular employee work.
entries.78fcde4cd1ba6e49: The business concludes outsourcing or temporary staffing contracts with client companies, and either re-outsources work to registered professional talent or employs such talent on fixed-term contracts and dispatches them to client companies. Many of the projects involve core system development from requirements definition to basic design, as well as strategy formulation, PMO, IT and business improvement consulting, and the business specializes in individuals with advanced capabilities commanding high person-month rates. The company also provides recruitment support for regular employment as a licensed employment placement service. The group has a single segment, the Professional Talent Business, and revenue by business is not disclosed.
entries.86fd594d50d619ca: Small and medium-sized enterprises in rural areas
entries.b5f0c6df470612c1: A consulting service that supports clients' problem-solving through teams of professional talent.
entries.ca7b23728823aa8e: Client companies (operating companies in finance, healthcare, manufacturing, information and communications, and other fields)
entries.cc1aafd26336231b: This core service is carried out in two ways: re-outsourcing the work it has received to talent registered in the professional talent registration system "FreeConsultant.jp", and employing talent on fixed-term contracts and dispatching them to client companies.
entries.dae80c9d3d5c9cbe: The company operates "ConsulNext.jp", a career change support service for consultants in their 20s and 30s, and "CAREER Knock", an information media service aimed at expanding the career mobility of professional talent.
